patterns.note: Full-bleed hero and banner images span the entire viewport width, creating an immersive visual experience.
Prominent, oversized, uppercase section headings are initially partially off-screen and reveal themselves as the user scrolls, acting as strong visual dividers.
A monospace font is consistently used for body text, product details, and smaller labels, providing a distinct, technical feel.
A limited color palette of black, white, and various greys is accented by warm orange/brown tones, primarily from product imagery and subtle UI elements.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections and product grids simply scroll into view from the bottom without any additional fade-in or slide animations, maintaining a straightforward content flow.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is fixed to the top of the viewport, remaining visible as the user scrolls. Content sections are presented sequentially, scrolling into view from the bottom of the screen with no additional animation. Large, impactful section titles are initially partially off-screen and reveal their full text as the user scrolls down, creating a dynamic typographic reveal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, condensed uppercase headings (easily 5-8x body text) contrast sharply with small, regular-weight monospace body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all elements, images, and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing within product grids, but very dense and impactful typography for section titles, creating a strong visual rhythm.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its use of extremely large, partially obscured, uppercase section headings that scroll into full view, creating a bold, almost brutalist typographic statement. This, combined with a clean, grid-based product display and a monospace body font, gives it a unique, editorial, and almost underground feel for an e-commerce site.
